import json,pathlib,warnings
from werkzeug.wrappers import Response
import werkzeug.wrappers.response as module
assert pathlib.Path(module.__file__).resolve()==pathlib.Path('/work/src/werkzeug/wrappers/response.py')
rows=[]
for flag in (True,False):
 for kind in ('str','bytes'):
  r=Response();r.implicit_sequence_conversion=flag
  values=('foo','bar') if kind=='str' else (b'foo',b'bar')
  appended='baz' if kind=='str' else b'baz';r.response=values
  assert r.is_sequence
  with warnings.catch_warnings(record=True) as seen:
   warnings.simplefilter('always')
   size=r.stream.write(appended)
   assert isinstance(r.response,list)
   assert r.response==[*values,appended]
   assert r.get_data()==b'foobarbaz'
  assert size==3
  rows.append({'implicit_sequence_conversion':flag,'kind':kind,'response':repr(r.response),'data':repr(r.get_data()),'write_length':size,'warnings':[str(w.message) for w in seen]})
print(json.dumps({'import':module.__file__,'rows':rows},indent=2))
